001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.systemlogger;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004import java.util.ResourceBundle;
005import java.util.function.Supplier;
006
007import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEvent;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogRouter;
011
012/**
013 * Rainbow Gum System Logger implementation. As noted in the module doc this can be used
014 * by others without worry of it registering a {@link System.LoggerFinder}.
015 *
016 * @apiNote This class is final and cannot be extended. If you think it would be useful to
017 * extend file an issue.
018 */
019public final class RainbowGumSystemLogger implements System.Logger {
020
021        private final String loggerName;
022
023        private final LogRouter router;
024
025        private final SystemLoggerEventFactory eventFactory;
026
027        /**
028         * Provides a system logger that will use the given root router.
029         * @param loggerName standard dotted logger name.
030         * @param router root router usually the global.
031         * @return un-cached system logger.
032         */
033        public static RainbowGumSystemLogger of(String loggerName, LogRouter router) {
034                return new RainbowGumSystemLogger(loggerName, router);
035        }
036
037        RainbowGumSystemLogger(String loggerName, LogRouter router) {
038                super();
039                this.loggerName = loggerName;
040                this.router = router;
041                this.eventFactory = new SystemLoggerEventFactory(loggerName);
042        }
043
044        private LogEvent event(Level level, @Nullable String formattedMessage, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
045                return eventFactory.eventNoArg(level, formattedMessage, throwable);
046        }
047
048        @Override
049        public String getName() {
050                return this.loggerName;
051        }
052
053        @Override
054        public boolean isLoggable(Level level) {
055                return router.route(loggerName, SystemLoggerEventFactory.fixLevel(level)).isEnabled();
056        }
057
058        @Override
059        public void log(Level level, @Nullable String msg) {
060                this._log(level, msg, (Throwable) null);
061        }
062
063        /*
064         * java.lang.System.Logger#log(Level, Supplier<String>) declares Supplier<String>, not
065         * Supplier<@Nullable String>, but like the single-String log(Level, String) overload
066         * right above, a supplier returning null is treated the same as no message - accepted
067         * wider than the JDK's own unannotated interface requires, same reasoning as
068         * rainbowgum-slf4j's MDCAdapter/LoggingEventBuilder astubs.
069         */
070        @SuppressWarnings({ "exports", "NullAway" })
071        @Override
072        public void log(Level level, Supplier<@Nullable String> msgSupplier) {
073                this._log(level, msgSupplier, (Throwable) null);
074        }
075
076        @Override
077        public void log(Level level, Object obj) {
078                Objects.requireNonNull(obj, "obj");
079                level = SystemLoggerEventFactory.fixLevel(level);
080                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
081                if (route.isEnabled()) {
082                        String formattedMessage = obj == null ? "" : obj.toString();
083                        LogEvent event = event(level, formattedMessage, null);
084                        route.log(event);
085                }
086        }
087
088        @Override
089        public void log(Level level, @Nullable String msg, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
090                this._log(level, msg, throwable);
091        }
092
093        // To keep call depth consistent
094        private void _log(Level level, @Nullable String msg, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
095                level = SystemLoggerEventFactory.fixLevel(level);
096                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
097                if (route.isEnabled()) {
098                        LogEvent event = event(level, msg, throwable);
099                        route.log(event);
100                }
101        }
102
103        @SuppressWarnings({ "exports", "NullAway" })
104        @Override
105        public void log(Level level, Supplier<@Nullable String> msgSupplier, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
106                this._log(level, msgSupplier, throwable);
107        }
108
109        // To keep call depth consistent
110        private void _log(Level level, Supplier<@Nullable String> msgSupplier, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
111                level = SystemLoggerEventFactory.fixLevel(level);
112                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
113                if (route.isEnabled()) {
114                        String formattedMessage = msgSupplier.get();
115                        LogEvent event = event(level, formattedMessage, throwable);
116                        route.log(event);
117                }
118        }
119
120        @Override
121        public void log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String msg, @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
122                _log(level, bundle, msg, throwable);
123        }
124
125        private void _log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String msg,
126                        @Nullable Throwable throwable) {
127                level = SystemLoggerEventFactory.fixLevel(level);
128                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
129                if (route.isEnabled()) {
130                        String formattedMessage = eventFactory.message(bundle, msg);
131                        LogEvent event = event(level, formattedMessage, throwable);
132                        route.log(event);
133                }
134        }
135
136        @Override
137        public void log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String format, @Nullable Object... args) {
138                this._log(level, bundle, format, args);
139        }
140
141        // To keep call depth consistent.
142        private void _log(Level level, @Nullable ResourceBundle bundle, @Nullable String format, @Nullable Object... args) {
143                level = SystemLoggerEventFactory.fixLevel(level);
144                var route = router.route(loggerName, level);
145                if (route.isEnabled()) {
146                        String message = eventFactory.message(bundle, format);
147                        LogEvent event = eventFactory.eventArgs(level, message, args);
148                        route.log(event);
149                }
150        }
151
152}
